scope_note: PET107-candidate print/buy/manufacture lines only, restricted to parts from the master engine BOM judged printable (polymer FDM/FFF, PETG-PET-class, non-structural, non-hot, non-oil-wet) or buy-catalog (commercial consumables with a purchasable identity). Every selection below is an ASSUMPTION-class lane judgement: no local source declares any of these parts as a PET107 print candidate. The evidence level per line is the best level carried by the master BOM evidence fields (identity/dims/interfaces/loads) mapped to the research-doc ladder.

evidence_ladder.FACT_public: published by Porsche (brochure, official workshop manual / parts guide)
evidence_ladder.measured_source: official 993 Repair Manual torque values registered in catalog/manual/993-workshop-manual-measurements.json; factory-specified, not project-measured
evidence_ladder.SINGLE_SOURCE: one secondary source (includes vendor-declared catalogue data)
evidence_ladder.ASSUMPTION: engineering inference recorded as assumption; promotes nothing

mapping_rules: sourced + at least one FACT_public citation -> FACT_public
sourced + at least one measured_source citation, no FACT_public -> measured_source
missing -> UNKNOWN (line kept only when it is a buy-catalog consumable or a study print target with an explicit gap note)

excluded_notes: Hot-side parts (exhaust manifolds M64B-IN-003, catalytic section M64B-IN-004, turbine wheels, wastegate actuator M64B-TR-003): beyond PET-class polymer temperature; excluded from this lane.
Oil-wet parts (oil tank M64B-OL-001, oil cooler M64B-OL-002, pump M64B-CC-002): PET-class oil compatibility unvalidated; excluded.
Structural/safety parts (engine carrier M64B-MT-001 PET safetyLevel 7, mounts, clutch, flywheel, head studs M64B-FG-001): load-bearing metal; excluded from print; buyable but not PET107 lane scope.
Turbochargers M64B-TR-001/002 and intercooler cores M64B-IC-001: buy as assembled catalogue units, not print-or-manufacture candidates for this lane.
Valvetrain, crank train, cylinders, heads, pistons: metal engine internals; no polymer print path evidenced.
